## Highlights

The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022:

- Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed.
- Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost.

versions.name: v5.1.51
versions.body:
5.1.49 and 5.1.50 were not published; their changes ship here. Session startup and task RPC attachment no longer wait for task-host liveness probes. Recovery runs independently per host, stops claiming or reviving children after shutdown, and preserves newer ownership claims. ([#11335](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11335)) DAG recovery and workpool reconciliation now wait for that same session-start reconcile (one shared gate) without holding admission, so a paused DAG's revivable child is never judged orphaned and a queued workpool item of an orphaned worker is redelivered rather than marked delivery_uncertain. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) Continuing a synchronous task whose session was already deleted now fails at once with an error saying to start a new task, instead of waiting out the 30-minute sync poll timeout; a sync poll also stops when the server keeps reporting its session as not found. Completed sync task sessions now honor `background_task.taskCleanupDelayMs` instead of a fixed 10 minutes. Reported by @orgito. ([#11524](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11524), fixes [#11520](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11520)) **omo.dev deploys again after the document-shell change.** The `/design` showcase became a root layout of its own and lost the hourly revalidation it used to inherit, so one prerendered page had no expiry and the deploy's asset-retention check refused the build. The design layout revalidates hourly again, within the site's one-hour HTML lifetime. ([#11587](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11587), fixes [#11585](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11585)) Release pull requests no longer fail the changelog gate when fragments for the next release land on the base branch after the cut. ([#11574](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11574)) - Release preparation no longer fails its own command-string audit when changelog fragments have been folded into the changelog. ([#11562](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11562)) **The frontend skill now builds in ten habits that design reviewers check for.** Before designing a new screen, a redesign, or a design system, it reads the guideline source in full, defines the ideal state per persona and journey step, and records every gap in a ledger. Controls keep the same box size in every state, and a spinner or arrow never adds padding. Pointer targets are at least 24 px, colour roles come before components (built from shadcn/ui anatomy), glass and dated trend surfaces stay out unless the brief asks for them, and the subtract pass counts the controls. versions.body:
**OmO Native stops waiting on a stalled turn-end subscriber after two seconds.** Memory recovery remains retryable without treating the cancelled wait as a failed reflection run, and stall diagnostics identify the component and hook instead of only `omo.js`. Thanks to @floweredao for the report. ([#11254](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11254), Part of [#11249](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11249)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Warm memory prompts avoid repeated git processes for HEAD and agreements.** Committed agreement reads are cached by repository and full revision, and cache misses inspect only the ledger path. Standard file-backed HEADs resolve from stat-validated Git files, including packed refs and linked worktrees, with git fallback for unusual layouts. ([#11216](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11216), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Unchanged memory notices no longer yield a warm prompt to cold recall.** Soul and agreement notices read their small atomic watermarks directly and skip lock acquisition only when valid state confirms nothing needs announcing or updating. Missing, malformed, or unreadable state is rechecked under the identity lock. Writers publish through unique, exclusively created temporary files, flush them before rename, and sync the directory where supported. ([#11215](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11215), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Memory notices survive a directory-sync failure after publication.** Soul and agreement watermarks still flush before atomic rename and attempt directory sync, but a sync error after publication is logged without discarding that turn's announcement. Failed writes clean up their temporary files, repeated agreement ids use set comparison, and HEAD reads defer to git for worktree configuration. ([#11234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11234), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Nested in-process tasks retain their original session tree.** A child's own tasks now record the tree root and increasing depth, so nested delegation obeys `max_depth` instead of restarting at depth 1. The root session's own view now also covers its nested in-process descendants: the footer, `/tasks`, the default `task_output` list, and `task_send` and cancel. Process-mode descendants already appeared there. ([#11226](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11226)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Nested team members retain the original session tree.** A child session leading a team now gives each member its own session as parent and the original tree root, with depth increasing from the lead. Persisted member ancestry is preserved when rebuilding a respawn. ([#11229](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11229)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**The engine moves to senpi 2026.10.25-2: resuming a session interrupted mid-run no longer crashes, startup with many skills is fast again, long sessions keep their prompt cache when the context-budget reminder appears, and the per-request engine turn limit is off by default ([#11240](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11240)).** With 748 skills, startup drops from 83.2 s to 1.4 s, fixing the slow start since 5.1.45 ([#11245](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11245)). In a long session that crossed the reminder at about 714k tokens of context, the request now writes 44k cache tokens instead of 758k. `engineTurns.maxPerUserInput` turns the turn limit back on; the 6-hour turn runtime cap still applies. Compaction finds a shorter safe tail when the summary would not fit. Kimi Code serves Kimi K3.1 Pro. A session that restarts or clears its queue no longer receives another session's queued messages twice. Claude subscription sessions run their SDK children in the session's project folder, so home-level Claude Code memory and settings no longer load into every session. MCP forms cancel instead of submitting empty answers when dismissed. Claude Code auto memory is never injected into Anthropic subscription sessions.

**A ulw-research run cannot produce a reader-facing artifact against an undecided brief.** The deliverable interview now also records a `## Fidelity` block, and the new `scripts/fidelity-policy.mjs` registry turns it into the rules the CLI enforces: `fact fill`, `fact verify`, `fact pairs`, `fact meaning-check`, `fact polish-apply` and `fact polish-diff` refuse an unlocked brief with one `fidelity_interview_incomplete` defect and write nothing, each reading `--brief` (default `$SESSION_DIR/brief.md`), while collection keeps running; `fact fill` then refuses a derived row under `derived numbers: none`, evaluates the source floor live against each source's `meta.json`, binds a translation to its quote only under `languages ... with translation beside`, and omits a twice-failed sentence under `fallback: omit`. Off-table `derived numbers` or `fallback` values are usage errors instead of silently allowing; under any floor but `standard` a row with no source is refused; and the fill map records the brief's hash, so `fact verify` refuses an edition filled under a different brief (`brief_changed`) and re-checks every value against the current one. ([#11166](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11166), closes [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

### Fixed

- Remove automatic `process_crashed` telemetry that used ordinary usage settings without separate crash consent. Starting a session no longer harvests operational crash records; manual `/bug` reports remain separate. ([#11258](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11258)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

versions.name: v5.1.46
versions.body:
**OmO Native init-deep committed mode no longer dead-ends.** Committed mode now finishes through its own pull-request handoff instead of pointing at a skill that does not ship with OmO Native, and it reports how to finish by hand when no PR can be opened. Thanks to @HolisticDeveloper for the report and @surlymochan for the fix. ([#11228](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11228), fixes [#9686](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9686))

**The stale-reflection-lock test leaves no background writer behind when removing its temporary root.** Its teardown closes the memory wiring and awaits facts reconciliation and maintenance before removal, so a late lock publication cannot recreate the directory and make the temp-leak guard blame another test. ([#11225](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11225))

**ulw-research ships a Markdown block model for checking Markdown and post deliverables.** It splits a Markdown report into headings, paragraphs, list items, table rows, code blocks and quotes with exact text offsets, and sorts sections with the same classifier as the HTML checks; an unclosed code fence is reported instead of passing silently, and no check uses it yet. The HTML checks now also treat a section headed exactly "Closing" as the closing section. ([#11153](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11153), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**ulw-research ships checked polish edits and a polish diff for research reports.** Polish changes text nodes only: tags, every attribute, comments, and script/style/template content stay byte-identical, including attribute order and quoting. `polish-apply` rejects markup changes and edits that change a fact, number, unit, ticker, or required hedge, and checks cumulative edits against the original report; `polish-diff` applies the same rules to the whole report. An edit may not contain `<`, `>` or `&`, and may not touch a character reference even without them; both gates also compare the whole-document skeleton (every markup token and every character reference, byte for byte), so entities and markup are left untouched. Both gates refuse documents with markup the checker cannot model exactly. Markup changes require the full fidelity gates. Severities come from the defect registry. Nothing in the CLI calls them yet. ([#11152](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11152), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**Re-extracting a conversation no longer counts the same agreement correction again.** Corrections are bound to validated user turns and recorded atomically with their replay receipts. Distinct turns on the same date still count separately; acknowledgement, drop and eviction retain replay history. Pending records from older versions use a documented agreement/date migration. ([#11214](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11214), fixes [#11191](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11191))

**The LSP MCP server negotiates supported protocol versions.** It preserves supported client versions and answers unsupported or missing versions with `2025-06-18`, rather than claiming an arbitrary protocol revision. ([#11208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11208))

**Skill MCP tool errors are reported as errors.** Structured output and result metadata reach the caller, tool failures are not retried as connection failures, and plain content keeps its existing output format. ([#11207](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11207))

**The repository now has a security policy.** `SECURITY.md` explains how to report a vulnerability privately through GitHub's Security tab, what to include, and when to expect triage and an acknowledgement; `CONTRIBUTING.md` links to it. Adapted from the policy proposed by @marklapointe in [#10752](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10752). ([#11221](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11221))

**ulw-research can check that a report's sentences keep the meaning of their sources.** It pairs each report sentence with the quote, claim or original text it rests on, and records drift only when two independent readers name the same kind of change; a single reader's flag is kept as a minor warning. A pair no reader judged, or a pair that needs the strong reader and only got the cheap one, is reported as unverified instead of passing as clean. Nothing in the CLI runs it yet. ([#11151](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11151), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**Skill MCP catalogs include every page.** Tools, resources, and prompts follow opaque pagination cursors in order, with a clear error if a server exceeds 100 pages. ([#11204](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11204))

**`omo update` on Windows survives a package file that another process holds.** When `bun add -g` fails with `EPERM` (`NtSetInformationFile`) because a file of the install is in use, `omo update` retries twice with a short backoff. If the file stays held, it names the file and the omo processes holding it, tells you to quit them and run `omo update` again, and keeps whatever version is installed, reinstalling the previous one only if the failed run left an unreadable install. ([#10090](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10090), [#11125](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11125))

**A held abandoned test directory no longer fails a new run during preload.** Cleanup retries through the shared tree remover, skips roots still held with EBUSY, EPERM, ENOTEMPTY or EACCES, and continues with the other abandoned roots. Unrelated filesystem errors still fail the run, and Bun's panic-only retry keeps its existing test-failure checks. ([#11190](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11190), refs [#11135](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11135) and [#8990](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8990))

**Usage summaries from older versions no longer stay on disk after an upgrade.** Versions 5.1.34 to 5.1.44 kept session summaries in a `rollups` folder that nothing reads or sends any more. The first start after upgrading now deletes it, whether telemetry is on or off, and never follows a link out of that folder. With telemetry turned off in `omo.json`, a summary file that was cut short by a crash is deleted too. ([#10234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10234)) ([#11147](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11147)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Computer-use cancellation retains engine crash diagnostics.** Cancelled and timed-out calls keep their error code and carry the engine exit diagnostic as their cause. Capability-query permission failures remain structured tool results, hard engine diagnostics survive unrelated successful replies, and legacy launch refusals now share the structured record's exit-code and UTF-8 size rules. ([#11150](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11150)) Follow-up to [#11086](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11086), part of [#11073](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11073). (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Reflection and dream children share a machine-wide FIFO concurrency cap.** The default is one running child across memory identities, configurable with `memory.reflection.max_concurrent_runs`. Queued runs retain their execution budget and remain protected from crash reconciliation until admitted. ([#11161](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11161), fixes [#11154](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11154)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Memory reflection no longer stops for good when its host dies during a run.** If the host died after a run had finished but before it was published, `runtime/reflection/active.lock` stayed held and every later reflection request only queued behind it until someone removed the file by hand. Now `/reflect` and every later turn settle a run whose launcher and publish claimant are both gone and whose outcome was recorded, so the queued request runs. A lock whose owner can't be checked is never reclaimed; it is reported with the next step, in the session and in `omo doctor`. Thanks to @Bearmancer for the report. ([#10377](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10377), [#10388](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10388), [#10528](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10528)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**One bad memory entry no longer discards a whole reflection run, and credential-shaped prose is not a secret.** Completion validation used to fail the entire run when any entry was refused (secret-like content, invalid frontmatter, a `description` over 1024 characters), so automatic reflection parked after a few runs. It now rewrites the run's branch as one commit without the refused entries, keeps the valid ones, and reports each dropped path with its reason (never the matched value); a run whose entries are all refused lands as no changes. The secret scanner and the pre-commit hook no longer flag assignments whose value only refers to a secret (`process.env.X`, `$VAR`, `{{ slot }}`, `[FILTERED]`, the `Bearer` word, null/example literals), while a real value still matches. The dream's `path_orphan` finding now says when a file has no frontmatter, and its persona tells it to add a `description` in the same commit as the move instead of a bare `git mv`, which validation refused on every run. Thanks to @PGY0403 (#10385) and @floweredao (#10511) for the reports. ([#10385](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10385), [#10511](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10511), [#10528](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10528)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Held packaging-test directories are recorded without failing cleanup.** The packed memory-sync probe and abandoned-root sweep share one best-effort removal guard, with no retries. Every held root is printed in the test log; Windows diagnostics are bounded to 30 seconds and include the holder's pid, image and parent pid when identified, or the diagnostic failure. Unrelated filesystem errors and unrecorded leaks still fail. ([#11218](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11218), part of [#11135](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11135))

versions.name: v5.1.44
versions.body:
**The engine moves to senpi 2026.10.21-3: long 1M-context conversations stop re-writing their cached prefix, Anthropic subscription context is counted once, and "No credential slots available" no longer locks every account out ([#10965](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10965)).** When context reduction trims a long conversation on a 1M window, the reduced prefix now stays identical and keeps its cache checkpoint, so each step writes only what changed. Anthropic subscription turns with internal SDK re-requests no longer double the context percentage or start compaction early, and a configured compaction model now summarizes while your session provider is healthy, overflow recovery included. The subscription lane is the only layer that picks its accounts, so one revoked or briefly rate-limited account no longer blocks the rest until you log in again. Every turn end says what happens next, a turn-end report names the hold your queued message released, the trailing "Anything else? (optional)" card is gone from clients without native questions, and moving a session between machines runs through one implementation. Forced recovery after a context overflow no longer picks the same compaction cut again when an invisible entry leads the session; an overflow still never moves a task to its next fallback model.
